fc1.title: ALSVID FC1 step-through carbon folding e-bike
fc1.description: Explore the ALSVID FC1 carbon folding e-bike with a low step-through frame, compact fold and front and rear suspension. Supplier reference specifications are clearly distinguished from the final ALSVID configuration, which is pending confirmation.
fc1.eyebrow: ALSVID FC SERIES · WORKING MODEL FC1
fc1.heading: A little lower. A lot more open.
fc1.intro: A carbon step-through folding e-bike built around a 40 cm low step, a compact fold and front and rear suspension. The photographs show the supplier's green, seven-speed chain sample; ALSVID's approved retail build and finish are still to be confirmed.
fc1.photo.alt: Supplier photograph of the 20-inch green low-step carbon folding e-bike in its seven-speed chain configuration
fc1.photo.note: Supplier sample · seven-speed chain configuration · photographed finish, colour code pending
fc1.preview_note: This is a supplier-reference product preview, not a confirmed live retail offer.
fc1.metric.weight: chain sample incl. battery and kickstand
fc1.metric.range: stated maximum on the standard battery¹
fc1.colours.title: Colour should feel like yours.
fc1.colours.body: Only the supplier's green photographed sample is evidenced. The colour code and production finish for ALSVID FC1 have not been approved. Select a colour direction below to flag your preference; proposal swatches do not represent available stock or a changed bicycle photograph.
fc1.colours.proposal_selected: Selected direction: {colour}. The sample photograph stays unchanged while supplier approval is pending.
fc1.colours.none_selected: The photographs always show the real green supplier sample.
fc1.colours.disclaimer: Colour directions for discussion only. Availability, paint code, sample approval, minimum order, lead time and colour tolerance are unconfirmed.
fc1.section.entry.title: Step through and set off.
fc1.section.entry.body: The supplier specifies a 40 cm step-over on a shaped carbon low-step frame with 20-inch wheels. The original frame line and component positions are shown in the product photographs.
fc1.section.fold.title: Ready for the ride. Ready to tuck away.
fc1.section.fold.body: Switch between the real side and folded photographs of the same seven-speed chain sample. The supplier's reference folded dimensions are 85 × 69 × 48 cm; measurement axes and production tolerance remain to be confirmed.
fc1.fold.caption: State comparison, not a folding instruction. Use the approved FC1 manual for the folding order and latch checks.
fc1.section.detail.title: Comfort and control live in the details.
fc1.section.detail.body: Select a numbered point or photo to see the supplier's original detail photograph. Component names below identify the supplier's reference and still need a final FC1 build-sheet check.
fc1.hotspot.front.body: The front suspension sits within the carbon-fork profile. Travel, setup and service instructions require confirmation for the approved FC1 build.
fc1.hotspot.rear.body: The supplier lists a DNM air shock within the rear-frame layout. Confirm exact model, spring travel and settings against the final build sheet.
fc1.hotspot.chain.body: The photograph shows the seven-speed Shimano chain sample. This is not a photograph of the optional single-speed belt configuration.
fc1.hotspot.controls.body: A close-up of the supplier sample's handlebars and display. Confirm display model, assist modes, ingress protection and connections for FC1.
fc1.section.drive.title: Assistance that follows your pedal input.
fc1.section.drive.body: The published European reference pairs a torque sensor with a 250 W rear-hub motor and 40 Nm torque. Assistance cuts off at 25 km/h, with no throttle. ALSVID's exact motor, tuning and conformity file remain to be matched to the final build.
fc1.drive.cutoff: EU reference assist cutoff · no throttle
fc1.market.title: Market-specific option
fc1.market.body: A 350 W motor and throttle are listed as supplier options outside the European reference. They are not the proposed EU FC1 setup; market rules and matching documents must be confirmed before offering them.
fc1.section.battery.title: Removable energy, neatly integrated.
fc1.section.battery.body: The published reference uses a removable, lockable 36 V 10 Ah (360 Wh) seatpost battery. Charging is listed at 4–6 hours. An optional bottle battery is mounted at the frame cage and runs separately, not at the same time as the standard battery.
fc1.battery.range_note: ¹ Up to 80 km is the supplier's stated maximum on the standard battery, not a guaranteed distance. Assist level, terrain, rider weight, weather and riding style affect actual range.
fc1.section.config.title: Choose a rhythm, then approve the build.
fc1.config.chain.title: Seven-speed chain sample
fc1.config.chain.body: Photographed supplier reference. Stated weight: 15.5 kg including battery and kickstand. The picture shows a chain drive.
fc1.config.belt.title: Single-speed belt option
fc1.config.belt.body: Supplier-listed option. Stated weight: 14.5 kg including battery and kickstand. A matching belt-drive photograph and ALSVID retail variant are not confirmed.
fc1.config.note: No Pro or Standard retail trims have been confirmed. Final accessories, configuration-specific weight, SKU and availability need an approved FC1 build sheet.
fc1.section.specs.title: Every detail, clearly stated.
fc1.section.specs.body: Published reference data describes the supplier's platform. It does not by itself confirm ALSVID's final series build, local approval, certification or included accessories.

fc1.section.faq.title: Before the first ride, you might ask…
fc1.faq.0.q: What is the recommended rider height?
fc1.faq.0.a: The supplier reference says 160–190 cm and a maximum rider weight of 120 kg. Please check personal fit and saddle adjustment on the final bicycle.
fc1.faq.1.q: Is the bike 14.5 kg or 15.5 kg?
fc1.faq.1.a: The photographed seven-speed chain reference is 15.5 kg. The optional single-speed belt reference is 14.5 kg. Both figures include the battery and kickstand.
fc1.faq.2.q: How large is the bicycle when folded?
fc1.faq.2.a: The supplier states 85 × 69 × 48 cm. Confirm measurement axes, tolerance and accessory position for the approved FC1 build.
fc1.faq.3.q: Does it have suspension at both ends?
fc1.faq.3.a: The reference lists integrated carbon-fibre front suspension and a DNM rear air shock. Exact model, travel and tuning need final build confirmation.
fc1.faq.4.a: No. It is a stated maximum for the standard 36 V 10 Ah battery. Actual range depends on assist, route, rider weight, weather and riding conditions.
fc1.faq.5.q: Can the bottle battery run at the same time as the seatpost battery?
fc1.faq.5.a: The supplier states that the optional bottle battery runs separately from the standard battery, not simultaneously. Its capacity and switching method need confirmation.
fc1.faq.6.q: Is the European certification already confirmed for ALSVID FC1?
fc1.faq.6.a: No. The supplier says CE / EN 15194 documents can be reviewed for the final 250 W, no-throttle European reference. Confirm that the reports match the exact FC1 model, build and market before making a conformity claim.
fc1.faq.7.q: When will colours, prices and online orders be available?
fc1.faq.7.a: After ALSVID approves the colour sample, retail variant and final build, pricing, availability and shop listing can be confirmed. Current reference information is not a live stock or purchase offer.
fc1.cta.title: Make space for the next ride.
fc1.cta.body: Explore the reference build. The ALSVID shop will list FC1 when its colours, retail specification, price and availability are approved.
fc1.cta.shop_note: Shopify is the destination for live product listings, inventory and checkout.
